notes: deployment-procedures carries disable-model-invocation: true, so a natural-language request cannot auto-trigger it; it runs only on explicit invocation (/cbr:deployment-procedures). The prompts below are what a user says when invoking the command, and the evals verify it applies the 5-phase workflow (PREPARE, BACKUP, DEPLOY, VERIFY, CONFIRM), the pre-deploy checklist, a documented rollback plan, and post-deploy verification windows — not description-based triggering. This is guidance for a safe release, not the deploy executor itself.

evals.prompt: /cbr:deployment-procedures We're releasing v2.0 to production tomorrow — help me plan the rollout so we can back out safely if it goes wrong.
evals.expected_output: Selects the platform tier, walks the pre-deployment checklist (tests, review, prod build, env vars, migrations, backup, monitoring), lays out the 5-phase workflow with monitoring open during DEPLOY, and produces a documented rollback plan keyed to the symptom→action table plus the post-deploy verification windows (5 min / 15 min / 1 hr / next day).

evals.prompt: /cbr:deployment-procedures Set up a zero-downtime deployment workflow with a rollback strategy for our containerized microservices.
evals.expected_output: Recommends a zero-downtime strategy (rolling / blue-green / canary) matched to risk, defines the health-check and error-log verification steps, and documents rollback-first principles (speed over perfection, one change at a time, communicate, post-mortem after stable). Warns against the deploy anti-patterns (Friday deploy, skip staging, deploy without backup).

evals.prompt: Help me set up my local development environment with hot reload and seed data.
evals.expected_output: Should not fire, because deployment-procedures' NOT FOR explicitly excludes development environment setup — this is local dev tooling, not a production release.
